title: A seek anywhere into a re-encode gets its segment, whatever the film's audio
description: On the dogfood (2026-11-20) a seek to 1183 in a re-encode of a 4K film failed: the job said 'finding where the audio's packets fall: ffmpeg made no packet' and the segment was answered 500 again and again; the viewer got no picture. The film's audio was DTS-HD MA 5.1; that this is the cause is unverified. PRODUCT.md: jump anywhere and the picture, sound and subtitles are right from the first frame.
acceptanceCriteria: Reproduced first on a synthetic film, and the property that makes it fail named (the audio codec, its channel layout, the seek distance, the burned subtitle, the tone mapping, or another): the check fails on today's build for that reason

A seek far into a re-encode (past half of a film of at least 30 minutes) gets its segment, with picture and sound from its first frame, for each audio codec the dogfood library holds (at least AAC, AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS, DTS-HD MA, TrueHD, FLAC and Opus), in stereo and 5.1, and with and without a burned image subtitle
The same seek through a helper's chunk and through a failover's replacement job gets its segment

A segment that truly cannot be made is not asked for and refused 500 without end, and the log names the item id, the source id and the reason once per job. A play that starts or resumes at such a segment gets the app's dialog. In jellyfin-web, a seek to such a segment after playback has begun (D-040, invariant 37): the segment is answered 500 once, the player asks for it no more and asks no PlaybackInfo in the 30 seconds after, no job for that spec starts in that time, and the picture stops with no dialog; the scenario fails if any of these changes, including if a dialog appears, so that a client or server change that reaches the dialog is noticed and this criterion tightened
In jellyfin-web (e2e): a film with DTS-HD MA audio that is re-encoded is sought far in, and picture and sound play on
No viewer-visible change for films that seek today
notes: The dogfood's job 83, start=1183. No film title or path in checks, fixtures or the pull request. BL-021 (the 4K HDR TrueHD criterion has no check) closes with this task's TrueHD row.
